t: Makuuchi - Wikipedia
s: 1 month ago - Yokozuna (横綱; IPA: [jo̞ko̞d͡zɯᵝna]) is the highest rank in sumo. The name literally means 'horizontal rope' and comes from the most visible symbol of their rank, the rope (綱, tsuna) worn around the waist. The rope is similar to the shimenawa used to mark off sacred areas in Shinto, and like the shimenawa it serves to purify and mark off its content.
